001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.format;
002
003import java.util.List;
004
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.CaseChanging;
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.EnumAlias;
007
008/**
009 * Which thread fields the core <code>json5</code> and <code>logfmt</code> encoders write.
010 */
011@CaseChanging
012public enum ThreadFields {
013
014        /**
015         * Thread name as <code>thread</code>.
016         */
017        @EnumAlias("true")
018        NAME,
019        /**
020         * Thread id as <code>threadId</code>.
021         */
022        ID,
023        /**
024         * Thread id and name as <code>threadId</code> and <code>threadName</code>. The
025         * default, since a virtual thread's name is usually empty.
026         */
027        @EnumAlias("default")
028        BOTH,
029        /**
030         * No thread.
031         */
032        @EnumAlias("false")
033        NONE;
034
035        /*
036         * The field names written, which key values must not repeat.
037         */
038        List<String> fields() {
039                return switch (this) {
040                        case NAME -> List.of("thread");
041                        case ID -> List.of("threadId");
042                        case BOTH -> List.of("threadId", "threadName");
043                        case NONE -> List.of();
044                };
045        }
046
047        static ThreadFields parse(String value) {
048                return switch (value.strip().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)) {
049                        case "default" -> BOTH;
050                        case "true" -> NAME;
051                        case "false" -> NONE;
052                        default ->
053                                io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.enumValue(ThreadFields.class, value, "true", "false", "default");
054                };
055        }
056
057}
